name: figmify-api
description: MVP API for extracting public web styles for Figma.

dependencyJustifications.@types/node: Provides Node.js type declarations for TypeScript compilation.
dependencyJustifications.tsx: Runs the TypeScript development entry point with ESM support.
dependencyJustifications.typescript: Compiles and type-checks the TypeScript source as ESM.
dependencyJustifications.vitest: Executes the automated TypeScript test suite with ESM support.
